pcrf_routing_note: PCRF (Palestine Children's Relief Fund, EIN: 11-3320278) does NOT accept crypto directly. All cryptocurrency is held in the SolarPunk treasury and converted to USD monthly. The converted USD is then donated via pcrf.net/donate. Every conversion is documented here with: date, crypto amount, exchange rate, USD received, transaction ID.
